text:
Samir Patel: quick RFC follow-up — proposing a minimal 'request claim envelope' that travels with every metering event. idea: small header produced at ingress (or SDK opt-in) that contains stable provenance id, tenant_id, model_key, cost_hint, client_request_id, parent_claim_id (optional).
Dana Liu: prefer to generate at ingress for trust/consistency. SDK tagging is nice but we can't trust clients for billing-critical fields. also ingress can stamp region/hardware hints.
Jules: +1 for ingress but worried about cross-proxy duplication. we need strong idempotency key semantics and a clear canonicalizer before ledger write.
Priya Raman: sketched a minimal envelope schema below — includes a lightweight fingerprint and optional payload blob for audits. storing full blob everywhere is expensive; suggest store blob in cold storage and keep fingerprint + pointer in hot ledger.
Priya Raman: ```
{
  "envelope_id": "env_{{uuid}}",
  "provenance_id": "prov_abc123",
  "tenant_id": "tenant_42",
  "model": "redwood/gpt-medium:2026-02-01",
  "cost_hint": 12, // estimated token units
  "client_request_id": "cli_789",
  "parent_envelope_id": null,
  "fingerprint": "sha256:...",
  "payload_blob_path": "s3://metering-archive/2026/02/...",
  "created_at": 1726000000
}
```
Samir Patel: tradeoffs we discussed: compacted ledger (keep only last credit state + fingerprint) hugely reduces storage and write amplification but makes full replay/audit harder unless we keep cold blobs or sample retention. append-only ledger makes auditing trivial but costs more.
Dana Liu: for compliance customers we should support append-only export mode + long-term cold archive retention. default can be compacted by tenant with a 'retain_full_payload' flag.
Jules: we need clear on late-arrival handling: if a late event arrives with same envelope_id, reconciler must be able to rehydrate the fingerprint -> fetch blob -> rerun attribution. that implies cold store availability and a bounded retention window for accurate replays.
metering-bot: Reminder: please file a short RFC outline in RFC board + tag @eng-platform @legal within 48h :robot_face:
Priya Raman: action items: 1) small spike to produce envelopes at ingress and persist fingerprint+pointer for 30k reqs; 2) evaluate overhead of pointer resolution during reconcile; 3) propose API surface for SDK opt-in tagging; 4) draft tenant-level retention knobs.
Samir Patel: thanks — I'll open the RFC and assign the spike to @Priya. cc @Dana @Jules. If nobody objects I'll record this as follow-up for the metering roadmap. :thumbsup:
